question: I control Null Profusion and activate Isochron Scepter, copying the exiled instant card and casting the copy without paying its mana cost. Does Null Profusion's triggered ability trigger when I cast a copy of a card this way?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it triggers when you play a land card or cast a nonland card as a spell, not when you play a copy of a card.
expected.answer: The triggered ability will trigger when you play a land card or cast a nonland card as a spell. It won't trigger when you play a copy of a card, such as with Isochron Scepter.

whyHard: The copy really is cast, so players expect a 'whenever you play a card' trigger to see it, but a copy of a card is not a card.
